entrypoints.summary: A malicious web page issues browser fetch requests to the target sidecar's state and direct-invocation URLs.
The audited API registers POST v1.0/state/{storeName} to onPostState; its constructor also registers direct-messaging endpoints.

affected_components.role: Registers state API endpoints; processes state writes through BulkSet; relays direct invocations to directMessaging.Invoke.

code_slices.surrounding_context: The supplied API slice has no listener-binding, authentication middleware, or Content-Type/CORS enforcement implementation, so placement and exact behavior of the missing or later-added controls cannot be established here.
code_slices.vulnerable: The audited API registers POST state/{storeName}; onPostState parses the body into state.SetRequest records and calls the selected state store's BulkSet. onDirectMessage turns request details into an invoke request and calls directMessaging.Invoke.

negative_controls: No artifact supplies an end-to-end post-remediation rejection trace or test result.
observability.positive_marker: The state handler returns 201 after a successful BulkSet; the report's PoC identifies the state-write and invocation operations.

preconditions: A sidecar is listening on all interfaces under the report's default configuration.
The sidecar lacks API authentication and CSRF tokens under that configuration.
A same-network victim visits attacker-controlled content in a browser.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: A POST JSON-stringified array containing key order and value 1 to v1.0/state/statestore, plus a fetch to v1.0/invoke/nodeapp/method/order.
trigger_steps.summary: Serve a web page containing fetch calls for the sidecar state-write and direct-invocation URLs.

impact.affected_asset: Dapr sidecar state-store contents and application/component operations reachable through the sidecar.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause browser-mediated state writes and service-method invocation against an exposed local Dapr sidecar.
impact.security_effect: Unauthorized modification of sidecar-backed state and unauthorized invocation of local application methods/components from a victim browser on the same network.

causal_trace.summary: An attacker-controlled web page can cause a same-network victim's browser to send requests to the sidecar at its network address.

The report states that the default local sidecar listens on all interfaces and employs neither API authentication nor CSRF tokens, so a browser-originated request can reach a control-plane API without the intended authorized-local-caller boundary.

The state handler decodes the POST body into state.SetRequest values and calls the configured store's BulkSet; the direct-message handler constructs an invocation request and calls directMessaging.Invoke.

The report's malicious-page proof of concept writes an order value through the state endpoint and invokes nodeapp's order method, with the stated consequence of unauthorized access to or exploitation of local Dapr components.

failure.operation: Browser-originated POST reaches the state-write handler and calls BulkSet; browser-originated invocation reaches directMessaging.Invoke.

primary_invariant.kind: local control-plane requester authorization and browser-origin boundary
primary_invariant.statement: Sidecar state and invocation operations should only be reachable by an authorized caller rather than by arbitrary browser content from the local network.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The audit reports all-interface exposure with no default API authentication or CSRF token, while the exposed handlers accept state writes and direct invocations.

raw_refs.role: primary finding report and browser proof of concept

quality.review_notes: The primary audit provides a concrete browser PoC and explicitly reports mitigation by test-environment API-token configuration. The reviewed API slice confirms state-write and direct-invocation side effects, but does not contain listener binding, authentication middleware, CORS/Content-Type enforcement, a fixed upstream commit, or an end-to-end regression result. The supplied token test establishes only token retrieval and route-exclusion behavior, not DAP-01-006 prevention or test execution.

remediation.invariant_restored: Remote browser content cannot directly drive sidecar control-plane operations: remote reachability is removed by loopback binding and requests require authentication; JSON Content-Type enforcement makes requests subject to the browser CORS policy.
mitigation_classes: application/json Content-Type enforcement to engage browser CORS policy

oracle.channel: HTTP requests from a browser-hosted proof-of-concept page
oracle.expected_negative: With the reported mitigation configuration, unauthenticated remote-browser requests should not obtain the sidecar operation because the token is required and loopback-only exposure prevents remote reachability.
oracle.expected_positive: Under the reported exposed, unauthenticated configuration, a POST to v1.0/state/statestore can write the supplied key/value and a request to v1.0/invoke/nodeapp/method/order can invoke the method.
